notes: *even* is `added`: rule 16 gives an appositional *even* only to a marker standing on the very phrase it introduces, and no marker stands on `כָּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלֹּה`.
The suffix of `כֻּלֹּה` is the rectum of `כֹּל` and takes the whole *of it*, headed on the pronoun, while `כֹּל` keeps only *all* (rule 19).
